Class QueryFilter

java.lang.Object
org.troy.capstone.search_engine.QueryFilter
public class QueryFilter extends Object
The QueryFilter class is responsible for filtering search results based on a user query. It uses Apache Lucene to create an index of the item data and perform searches on it. Code was sourced from https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2600/integrating-search-in-your-application-with-apache-lucene-d11c6fb84ab4 and very heavily modified to fit my case.

  • Constructor Details

    • QueryFilter

      public QueryFilter(Table table)
      Creates a QueryFilter from a Table. The constructor initializes the Lucene index with the item data from the table, using a custom n-gram analyzer for better search performance and relevance scoring.
      Parameters:
      table - A Table containing the item data, with each row representing an item and containing columns for ID, Name, Description, etc. The constructor will create a Lucene index from this data for performing search queries.
      Preconditions:
      table is not null and contains the expected columns for creating Items (ID, Name, Description, etc.).

  • Method Details

    • search

      public Map<String,Float> search(String userQuery)
      Searches the index for items matching the user query and returns a map of item IDs to their relevance scores for the results that meet the score threshold. Logs any errors during search execution and returns an empty map in case of errors.
      Parameters:
      userQuery - The search query input by the user.
      Returns:
      A map of item IDs to their relevance scores for the search results that meet the score threshold. If no results are found or if there is an error during search execution, an empty map is returned.
      Preconditions:
      userQuery is not null or empty, and is a valid query string that can be parsed by the MultiFieldQueryParser.

    • getScoreDocs

      static ScoreDoc[] getScoreDocs(TopDocs results)
      Returns the array of ScoreDoc objects from the given TopDocs object. Only necessary to allow mocking for test purposes.
      Parameters:
      results - The TopDocs object containing the search results from which to extract the ScoreDoc array.
      Returns:
      The array of ScoreDoc objects from the given TopDocs object.
      Preconditions:

    • addDoc

      private void addDoc(Row row)
      Adds a document to the Lucene index based on a tablesaw Row of item data. The document includes the item ID, name, and description, with the name and description fields being indexed for searching and the ID field being stored for retrieval. Logs any errors during document addition.
      Parameters:
      row - A Row from a Table containing item info to be added to the Lucene index as a Document
      Preconditions:
      row is not null and contains the expected columns for creating a Document (ID, Name, Description, etc.).
      Postconditions:
      A Document is created from the provided Row and added to the Lucene index, with the ID field stored and the name and description fields indexed for searching. If there is an error during document creation or addition, it is logged and the method continues without adding the document.

    • createNgramAnalyzer

      private void createNgramAnalyzer()
      Creates a custom n-gram analyzer for indexing and searching, configured to use n-grams of the specified sizes for better typo tolerance and partial matching in search queries. If there is an error creating the custom analyzer, it falls back to a standard StopAnalyzer with English stop words.
